channel.title: Jeselnik Book Club
channel.description:
Anthony Jeselnik wants you to read books.
In Jeselnik Book Club, Anthony shares his obsessive passion for the benefits of reading literature—with contagious results. Every week, Anthony will discuss modern literary gossip and question popular culture with a series of guests, ranging from authors to celebrities, friends, and guests from your favorite Ringer podcasts.
Tune in to Jeselnik Book Club because you love to read or because you want to become a better, smarter, more beautiful person.
